title: Actual kernel conormal sections on an affine closed chart
statement: Let g:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], W⊂Y and U⊂X affine opens [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with g⁻¹W=U and h:U⊆g⁻¹W. Let r:R≃Γ(Y,W) be a ring isomorphism, and let I be the kernel of ρ=g.appLE(W,U,h)∘r, assumed surjective. Let K be the actual module-sheaf kernel of O_Y→g_*O_X and N=P_g K [def-pc-module-pullback]. Give Γ(N,U) its R-action through ρ. There exists an R-linear equivalence I/I²≃Γ(N,U), sending the class of a∈I to the restriction to U of the canonical pullback-unit image [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] of every s∈Γ(K,W) whose inclusion equals r(a).

source.place: Tag 01R3 (1), (2), combined with Tags 00A0 and 0096; read online 2026-10-13

proof.text: Set i=g.resLE W U h. Identify global sections of the open schemes with their ambient sections by W.topIso and U.topIso. Surjectivity of ρ and r imply surjectivity of i.appTop. Since both schemes are affine, Mathlib IsClosedImmersion.of_surjective_of_isAffine makes i a closed immersion. Under r followed by W.topIso.inv, the kernel of i.appTop is I: the U.topIso.inv factor is injective.
Apply affine_conormal_sections_existence to i, the top affine open of W, the transported ring coordinates, and I. It gives the semilinear quotient equivalence c and its exact unit formula.

Apply open_kernel_conormal_transport to obtain the open-chart section equivalence d. For any original kernel section s it supplies a local ideal section t with the same included function and identifies d of its local unit with the restricted original unit.

Compose the additive equivalences c and d. Their scalar formulas and W.topIso.hom∘W.topIso.inv=id make the composite R-linear through ρ. For a and s satisfying the inclusion equation, the local section t supplied by transport has inclusion equal to the transported r(a); rewrite c of the class of a by the affine unit formula and then apply the transport unit equation.
